title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1400: Sunmoon character, heaven weapon (1)

section.p: At the second eye, Su Yu gained even more benefits.
Both his eyes felt incredibly powerful now. His left eye was akin to a scorching sun while his right eye was akin to a frosty moon.
Fire and ice.
Now, Su Yu could kill just by staring at someone.
Observing from the side, Yellow Nine was alarmed. This guy had grown stronger than before. More importantly, hunting for treasures was as easy as taking something out of his own pocket for Su Yu.
After some time. Double Dragon Gorge.

The Double Dragon Gorge was a dangerous place. According to Su Yu’s deduction, this was the location of the nose. Two sealed valleys could be found in the Double Dragon Gorge, constantly covered in storms.
That was a place with countless treasures. The Double Dragon Gorge also produced a specialty product known as the dragonbind wood.

The dragonbind wood was a powerful wood capable of binding even dragons. It was excellent material for weaponsmithing. If one had enough of it, one could even forge a heaven weapon with it. It was rumored that at the end of the Double Dragon Gorge, some ancient dragonbind wood could be found. The wood there could even be used as carrier treasures.

Of course, that was merely a rumor. It had not been verified as nobody had been able to reach that place. The Double Dragon Gorge was simply too dangerous. The dragonbind wood was akin to living beings, capable of attacking any intruder in the area.
Outside the Double Dragon Gorge.
Su Yu laughed in amusement. Dragonbind wood?

No. Those were simply nasal hairs. That was the first thought of his. He was certain about that. According to the layout of the first level, the Double Dragon Gorge was the nose. The aggressive wood inside the nostrils was nothing but the nasal hairs.

According to the rumors, the dragonbind wood was powerful and tall. Each nasal hair was bigger than even a gigantic beast. And there would be quite a lot of them in the area. After all, the Double Dragon Gorge was hundreds of kilometers across.

A nose this big would most certainly contain numerous nasal hairs. The nasal hairs at the very depths of the nose could very well be strong enough to act as carrier treasures. However, any attempt to pluck even one nasal hair would most certainly be a dangerous process.
Just imagine plucking the nasal hair of someone forcefully. Would that person not flip out in anger?
“Double Dragon Gorge…”

Su Yu overlooked the gorge below from the air. There were a lot more people in the area. For many people, the spring of the Blood Plain wasn’t too particularly useful. However, the dragonbind wood was a treasure in its own right.
Even the dragonbind wood found at the outermost region of the gorge could be used to forge earth weapons. Those found in the deeper regions could be used to forge heaven weapons.
And those at the deepest region could very well serve as carrier treasures. For many people, this was the most valuable place on the first level. This was a land of treasure.
If one were capable enough, one might really walk away from this place with a carrier treasure. That would be an immense gain.

Thus, a majority of the people on the first level were gathered here. The rest had either departed for the second level right away or those who would only do a casual search of the first level before moving on to the second level.

When Su Yu arrived, there were already over a hundred people in the area. Shouts could be heard coming from the two massive holes on the ground. Clearly, some people were already inside. For Su Yu, the two holes were clearly nostrils. But the myriad races had their own legend about this place.

According to the myriad races, two ancient dragons used to reside here. One was a male while the other was a female. That was why this place was known as the Double Dragon Gorge. As per the legend, the treasures of the two dragons could be found at the depths of the gorge. Perhaps even the corpses of Invincibles could be found there. Thus, generation after generation, countless people had explored this place.

In truth, many were aware that the first level was shaped like a human face. They also knew that this place was essentially the nose. After all, the name of the level and some locations on the level had existed long before Su Yu was here.
Then again, not many gave it much thought. It was merely a design choice. Was this supposed to be the real nose of an actual human? What manner of nose could be hundreds of kilometers in size?
Su Yu’s arrival did not attract much attention. The people there were still busy talking among themselves.
“Do you think anyone will be able to leave with a 10000-year dragonbind wood this time?”
“Can that thing really serve as a carrier treasure?”

A carrier treasure was among the most valuable treasures many could hope to obtain from the mansion. On the first level, the 10000-year dragonbind wood was the most coveted treasure. Even if one didn’t need a carrier treasure, one could always offer it to an Invincible from one’s own race for numerous benefits.

If one came from a race without an Invincible, one could secretly offer it to a Pseudo Invincible. In that situation, one would either be silenced or rewarded massively. Then again, most of the people capable of entering the mansion were backed by Invincibles so this scenario would be quite rare.

At this time, Yellow Nine sent Su Yu a voice transmission, “According to the records of the pavilion, the Double Dragon Gorge is the greatest treasure vault of the first level. There is a limitless supply of dragonbind wood in there. Even the wood found at the outer regions is extremely valuable. This is also the favourite weaponsmithing material fo many weaponsmiths.”

She looked around and asked, “There are a lot of people here. Are you killing them all as well? Things might get troublesome for you after you leave the mansion if you kill too many of them. Try to kill fewer people and let more of them leave the mansion. That will keep things chaotic and make it easier for you to slip off undetected. If you kill everyone, the few remaining survivors will be subjected to the scrutiny of all the Invincibles out there upon leaving. With all their people dead, nothing will hold the myriad race Invincibles back from doing something rash.”

She was right. With more survivors, the myriad race Invincibles would refrain from doing anything rash to protect their own people. Meanwhile, if only a handful of people survived, and all of them were humans, the myriad race Invincibles would most certainly go crazy.
Su Yu nodded, “You’re right.”

Yellow Nine exhaled in relief. At least he was rational enough to take this advice. That thought had barely crossed her mind when a book appeared and covered the sky. The people in the gorge were still completely oblivious.

Su Yu indifferently said, “Three-thousand-six-hundred people have entered. How many have died so far? There are about a thousand on the first level. Even killing all of them will only reduce the overall number by about a third. You have nothing to worry about.”
“You…”
Yellow Nine shivered. How murderous. At that point, someone finally sensed something. When they looked up, they saw a book covering the sky.
Culture. Radiance.

On the cover of the book were the culture and radiance characters. They seemed to emanate the essence of dao itself. The person looking out blanked out and muttered, “What is this? An ancient treasure?”
Someone else realized what it was. He exclaimed in alarm, “Run!”
He fled without hesitation.
At that time, the book flipped open. All the pages flew out and numerous projections emerged from the pages as Su Yu paled slightly.
This was an experiment. Three hundred projections, each a first-stage Sunmoon. Some were already near the second stage. In the blink of an eye, the projections grabbed the people in the area.

About a hundred people had gathered at the outskirts of the Double Dragon Gorge. Meanwhile, they were faced with three hundred Sunmoons. Yellow Nine’s jaw dropped in astonishment. Was this still an earth weapon? She found that hard to believe.
Something like this couldn’t be an earth weapon. It felt even more powerful than a heaven weapon. Just imagine the power three hundred Sunmoons could unleash.

Meanwhile, Su Yu was exhausting his source qi at a crazy rate. He was using way more power than he needed against these opponents, but this was merely an experiment. This was his best opportunity to get used to fighting this way. When he reached the higher levels, he wouldn’t have such opportunities anymore.
Apart from the humans, over a hundred people were dragged into the book. Su Yu paled even more due to the rapid exhaustion of his source qi.

He was still incapable of sustaining the appearance of three hundred Sunmoons. These were mere projections, powered mostly by the corpses he had collected. In truth, he was only supplying a small part of the energy required for this action.
Even so, the expenditure was enough to empty him out. In the blink of an eye, silence returned to the area. The three hundred pages returned to the book, some carrying new content on them.

Beside Su Yu, Yellow Nine was incomparably alarmed. Su Yu…was a true demon. The way he killed…was terrifying. As for Su Yu, he was too busy to pay any heed to her reaction. The two characters on the cover of his book were flickering, showing signs of advancement into Sunmoon characters.
The 109th golden stripe turned even more solid. It continued growing, but it failed to take form completely, as though it was still lacking something.
With a smile, Su Yu enlarged his book and covered the two holes on the ground. He said, “Let them have some fun inside. I’m smelling an advancement.”
He was not referring to the advancement of his cultivation level. Rather, he was talking about the culture and radiance characters.
His book was on the verge of advancement as well. It was only a step away from fully making the advancement.

That was not an issue. Su Yu took out a pile of materials. Then, a hammer appeared in his hand. A clump of flame appeared and melted all the materials in an instant. Then, he slammed his hammer down. He was forging more pages.

At the same time, he took a large machine out and tossed it at Yellow Nine. “Go. Cut some space for me. Make each chunk of space a thousand cubic meters in size. I require some space. The space here is very stable. It is comparable to the space in the Allheaven Battlefield.”
He aimed to add more pages. He still lacked the pages for many races. He aimed to forge those pages now. Even if he still didn’t have the Sunmoon blood essence of those races, it didn’t matter.
